summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (mid-April to mid-December). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at the full-hookup sites, 28 RV sites to 45 ft with 15 pull-throughs, dump station. Not stated for this park: showers at the campground (DCNR mentions a shower house only in the cabin colony), minimum/maximum stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left at the statewide table.
